title: Baseline load and chrome
dateUnderTest: Default **Specific Map** (whatever date the picker shows after load).

steps.name: Open map page
steps.expect: Page loads; zoo map SVG appears in the map mount; no hard failure / blank page.

steps.name: Explore panel visible
steps.expect: Panel titled **Explore** is visible with toggles, Filter, and search.

steps.name: Bottom nav links
steps.expect: Links include **Map**, **Animals**, Meet the Guardians (external), Wild Encounters (external), and **Itinerary**.

steps.name: Pan map
steps.expect: Map pans; markers move with the map.

steps.name: Zoom map
steps.do: Zoom in and out (scroll/pinch/controls as available).
steps.expect: Map zooms; markers remain attached to locations.

steps.name: Show region/pavilion text on
steps.do: Enable **Show region/pavilion text** if it is not already on (it may default checked).
steps.expect: Region/pavilion labels appear on the map.

steps.name: Default animal markers
steps.do: With default filters (Animals checked), observe the map.
steps.expect: Animal markers are visible on **Specific Map**; map mount is not empty/broken.
